name: pyscn-hierarchical-project-configuration-layers
instr:
pyscn cannot inherit analysis configuration from every governing directory. Build one deterministic effective request from shared root policy and local refinements, regardless of analysis entry point, while preserving explicit configuration behavior.

Discovery must produce a deduplicated `ConfigLayerPlan` of physical `ConfigLayer` values, ordered from project root to target, and treat file and directory targets consistently. Export `ConfigLoadMode`, `ConfigLoadDiscovered`, `ConfigLoadExplicit`, `ConfigLayerError`, and `LayeredConfigLoader` from `github.com/ludo-technologies/pyscn/domain`.

Nearer sparse layers replace only supplied fields. Independently preserve omitted, false, zero, slice, analyzer-specific, and default values for complexity, CBO, dead-code, DI anti-pattern, LCOM, community, and system analysis. Explicit mode loads only the selected file before entry-point overrides, preserving the existing missing-file category and wrapped cause.

Process layers atomically in order. The first unreadable or malformed layer returns `ConfigLayerError` with its physical identity, unwraps its cause, and prevents later layers from affecting the request. Complexity, CBO, dead-code, and system orchestration apply entry-point overrides after layering and validate only the final request.
